objective: Count how many of the six specified products have at least 1 item available today at the Graz Lend hardware shop.

params.store_id: lookup from stores WHERE store_name LIKE '%Graz Lend%' OR (city='Graz' AND store_name LIKE '%Lend%')
params.product_skus: for each product description (brand, series, model, property key-value pairs), lookup product_sku from product_variants matching brand, series, model, and then verify property matches in product_variant_properties; collect all matching skus
params.available_count: for each product_sku in product_skus, check store_inventory WHERE store_id = $store_id AND product_sku = $sku AND available_today_quantity >= 1; count distinct skus that satisfy
